name: National Christian Centre
subtitle: The National Christian Centre was first known as the National Ecumenical Centre.

facts.label: Construction
facts.value: Under construction for more than 20 years after the National Mosque was built

facts.label: Controversy
facts.value: The Emir of Gwandu, then chairman of the National Mosque board, objected to a government move to complete it

parts.text: The National Christian Centre was first known as the National Ecumenical Centre. A Daily Trust opinion piece says it remained under construction for more than 20 years and that a government move to complete it was contested.
